app.comment: The editor's name, such as Visual Studio Code or Cursor.

arch.comment: Processor type, such as arm64 or x64.

remote.comment: The kind of remote session (ssh-remote, wsl, dev-container…), or none.

readbysearch.code2pdf/activated.comment: Once each time the extension starts: whether code2pdf is there, and which installs this machine could use.

cli.comment: found, missing, tooOld, notAtSetting (the executable setting points nowhere) or error.

installKind.comment: How code2pdf was installed, as code2pdf --version says: Homebrew, Debian package, install.sh…

distro.comment: On Linux, the distribution and its version, such as ubuntu 24.04.

firstActivation.comment: Whether the extension starts for the first time on this machine.

readbysearch.code2pdf/installOffered.comment: The message offering to install or update code2pdf was answered or closed.

reason.comment: missing, tooOld, or notAtSetting (the executable setting points nowhere).

from.comment: print (a print command) or installCommand (the Install command or the Get Started page).

readbysearch.code2pdf/installFinished.comment: An install started from the message finished, failed or was cancelled, or 30 minutes passed without code2pdf appearing.

outcome.comment: ready, gaveUp (a terminal install, after 30 minutes), or failed or cancelled (the download on Windows).

command.comment: The install button chosen, such as Install with Homebrew.

seconds.comment: Time since the button was chosen.

installKind.comment: How it was installed, as code2pdf --version says.

readbysearch.code2pdf/print.comment: A print ended, or its save dialog was closed without saving.

kind.comment: file, selection, folder, files (several selected), chosen (checked in a list) or changes.

outcome.comment: printed, failed, cancelled, noPdf or saveCancelled.

openWith.comment: The code2pdf.openWith setting: viewer, editor or none.

exitCode.comment: code2pdf's exit code, when it failed.

error.comment: The system error code, such as ENOENT, when code2pdf couldn't be run.
